# Power metric definitions

Power model v1.7.0: 81 metrics across 7 sections.

Only public definitions are listed: what each metric represents, its unit, its direction, and its data status (`real` = official NHL data, `proxy` = documented stand-in, `none` = unavailable and scored neutral). Scoring formulas, normalization, aggregation, weights, data sources, and update internals are not published. Authenticated MCP clients can request the runtime manifest with `get_metric_definitions`.

## Front Office

Roster construction and front-office context signals.

- `capSpace` — Cap Space (millions of dollars · higher is better · status real).
  Uses the curated season cap-hit file against the season salary-cap ceiling; a team with less cap committed has more space. The free NHL API does not publish contracts, so the cap hits are a checked-in CapWages-derived dataset rather than a live feed.
- `depth` — Depth (skaters · higher is better · status real).
  Counts skaters with at least 20 points in the current target-season skater report.
- `lineupStability` — Lineup Stability (coefficient of variation · lower is better · status real).
  Measures how uneven skater participation is; less dispersion around the mean is better. Uses the GP>=20 regulars once they exist and every skater with a game played earlier in a season.
- `experience` — Team Experience in Playoffs (years · higher is better · status proxy).
  Uses average derived NHL seasons of experience over the active roster as a proxy for playoff experience.
- `avgAge` — Player Average Age (years · bell-shaped ideal · status real).
  Uses the current calendar age of the active skaters and applies a bell-shaped score centered at the production ideal.
- `avgHeight` — Team Average Height (inches · higher is better · status real).
  Averages the reported heights of the active skaters; taller is higher under the production direction.
- `avgWeight` — Team Average Weight (pounds · higher is better · status real).
  Averages the reported weights of the active skaters; heavier is higher under the production direction.

## Coaching

Preparation, line continuity, and in-game response signals.

- `lineStability` — Line Stability (games played · higher is better · status proxy).
  Uses average games played by the top six forwards and top four defensemen as a proxy for stable core lines and pairs.
- `wonCoachChallenges` — Won Coach Challenges (normalized score; no raw measurement · higher is better · status none).
  Won coach challenges are not exposed by the free NHL API used by production, so the metric is always neutral.
- `emptyNetSuccess` — Empty-Net Goals per Game (Proxy) (empty-net goals per game · higher is better · status proxy).
  Uses empty-net goals per team game as the production proxy for empty-net success.
- `comebackAfterTimeout` — Goals within 5 min after Coach Timeout (goals · higher is better · status real).
  Counts goals scored within five minutes after one of the team's own coach timeouts.
- `first10MinutesGoals` — First 10 Minutes Goals For/Against (ratio from 0 to 1 · higher is better · status real).
  Measures the share of first-ten-minute regulation goals scored for the team.
- `threePlusGoalRoutes` — 3+ Goal Routes (Blowout Losses) (blowout losses · lower is better · status real).
  Counts losses that were routes by at least three goals after removing the opponent's empty-net goals.

## Offense

Five-on-five and powerplay offensive production.

- `top5Ratio` — Top 5 Players Production Ratio · 5-on-5 (ratio from 0 to 1 · higher is better · status real).
  Measures the share of team skater points produced by the five highest-point skaters.
- `top9Fwd` — Average Points Top 9 Forwards · 5-on-5 (points per forward · higher is better · status real).
  Averages points among the nine highest-point forwards, with a single-game availability override when supplied.
- `top4D` — Average Points Top 4 Defensemen · 5-on-5 (points per defenseman · higher is better · status real).
  Averages points among the four highest-point defensemen, with a single-game availability override when supplied.
- `bottom6Fwd` — Bottom-6 Forwards Points/Game · 5-on-5 (points per game per bottom-six forward · higher is better · status real).
  Averages points per game among the forwards ranked 7-12 by ice time per game (the third and fourth lines), with a single-game availability override when supplied.
- `bottomPairD` — Bottom-Pair Defensemen Points/Game · 5-on-5 (points per game per bottom-pair defenseman · higher is better · status real).
  Averages points per game among the defensemen ranked 5-6 by ice time per game (the third pair), with a single-game availability override when supplied.
- `shotsPerGame` — Shots / Game · 5-on-5 (shots on goal per game · higher is better · status real).
  Uses official team shots on goal per game, with a play-by-play fallback for a new or incomplete season.
- `scoringChances` — Scoring Chances / Game · 5-on-5 (scoring chances per game · higher is better · status real).
  Counts all parsed play-by-play shot attempts—goals, shots on goal, missed shots, and blocked shots—whose production danger value is at least 0.1 and divides by games played.
- `shotAttemptsPerGame` — Shot Attempts / Game · 5-on-5 (shot attempts per game · higher is better · status real).
  Counts shot attempts from the play-by-play aggregate (the same source as scoring chances and shot quality), with the realtime report as fallback.
- `shotQuality` — Shot Quality (avg danger/attempt) · 5-on-5 (danger value per shot attempt · higher is better · status real).
  Averages the production play-by-play danger value assigned to the team's shot attempts.
- `plusMinus` — Plus/Minus Overall · 5-on-5 (plus/minus points · higher is better · status real).
  Sums the plus/minus values of the team's skaters.
- `offZoneTime` — Shot-Attempt Share (Off Zone Proxy) · 5-on-5 (shot-attempt share from 0 to 1 · higher is better · status proxy).
  Uses shot-attempt share as the production proxy for time in the offensive zone.
- `timeWithLead` — Time with the Lead · 5-on-5 (hours per game · higher is better · status real).
  Averages regulation time spent holding a lead across the team's games.
- `comeback2Plus` — Comebacks from 2+ Goal Deficit · 5-on-5 (comeback wins · higher is better · status real).
  Counts wins after the team trailed by at least two goals.
- `comebacks3rd` — Comebacks in 3rd Periods · 5-on-5 (comeback wins · higher is better · status real).
  Counts wins after the team trailed during the third period.
- `ppGoalsPerMin` — Goals / Powerplay Minute · Powerplay (powerplay goals per powerplay minute · higher is better · status real).
  Measures powerplay goals per powerplay minute.
- `ppPointsPerMin` — Points / Powerplay Minute · Powerplay (powerplay points per powerplay minute · higher is better · status real).
  Measures powerplay points (goals plus assists) per powerplay minute. This is the creation half of the powerplay: goals alone score finishing, and the unit's best passer generates them without scoring them.
- `ppTop5Ratio` — Top 5 Production Ratio vs Team (PP) · Powerplay (ratio from 0 to 1 · lower is better · status real).
  Measures the share of team powerplay points produced by the five highest-point powerplay skaters; concentration is lower-is-better.
- `ppTop2DRatio` — Top 2 Defensemen Production vs Team (PP) · Powerplay (ratio from 0 to 1 · lower is better · status real).
  Measures the share of team powerplay points produced by the two highest-point defensemen; concentration is lower-is-better.
- `shGoalsAgainst` — Shorthanded Goals Allowed · Powerplay (shorthanded goals against per game · lower is better · status real).
  Measures shorthanded goals allowed—goals against while the opponent is shorthanded—per game; fewer is better.

## Defense

Five-on-five and penalty-kill defensive suppression.

- `oppShotsPerGame` — Opponent Shots / Game · 5-on-5 (shots on goal against per game · lower is better · status real).
  Measures shots on goal allowed per game, with a play-by-play fallback.
- `goalAgainstPerGame` — Goals Against / Game · 5-on-5 (goals against per game · lower is better · status real).
  Measures goals allowed per game, with a play-by-play fallback.
- `oppTop9Fwd` — Opp Average Points Top 9 Forwards · 5-on-5 (opponent points per top-nine forward · higher is better · status real).
  Computes the opponent-weighted average points per opponent top-nine forward using actual games played against each opponent when available.
- `oppTop4D` — Opp Average Points Top 4 Defensemen · 5-on-5 (opponent points per top-four defenseman · higher is better · status real).
  Computes the opponent-weighted average points per opponent top-four defenseman using actual games played against each opponent when available.
- `oppScoringChances` — Opp Scoring Chances / Game · 5-on-5 (opponent scoring chances per game · lower is better · status real).
  Measures opponent scoring chances allowed per game.
- `oppShotAttemptsPerGame` — Opp Shot Attempts / Game · 5-on-5 (opponent shot attempts per game · lower is better · status real).
  Measures opponent shot attempts allowed per game from the play-by-play aggregate, symmetric with the team's own attempt count.
- `oppShotQuality` — Opponent Shot Quality (allowed) · 5-on-5 (danger value per allowed shot attempt · lower is better · status real).
  Averages the production danger value of shot attempts allowed.
- `oppPlusMinus` — Team Plus/Minus (Opponent Context; Audit) · 5-on-5 (negative plus/minus points · lower is better · status real).
  Uses the negative of the team's skater plus/minus as raw input and then applies lower-is-better normalization.
- `oppZoneTime` — Opponent Shot-Attempt Share (Zone Proxy) · 5-on-5 (opponent shot-attempt share from 0 to 1 · lower is better · status proxy).
  Uses opponent shot-attempt share as the production proxy for opponent offensive-zone time.
- `oppTimeWithLead` — Opp Time with the Lead · 5-on-5 (hours per game · lower is better · status real).
  Averages regulation time the opponent spent holding a lead, which is the team's trailing time.
- `oppComeback2Plus` — Opp Comebacks from 2+ Goal Deficit · 5-on-5 (opponent comeback wins · lower is better · status real).
  Counts opponent wins after the opponent trailed by at least two goals against this team.
- `oppComebacks3rd` — Opp Comebacks in 3rd Periods · 5-on-5 (opponent comeback wins · lower is better · status real).
  Counts opponent wins after the opponent trailed during the third period against this team.
- `backupGaa` — Auxiliary Goalie Goal Against Ratio · 5-on-5 (goals against average · lower is better · status real).
  Uses the announced non-main goalie's GAA when available; otherwise weights backup goalies' GAA by games played.
- `goalieGsaa` — Goals Saved Above Average (Team) · 5-on-5 (goals · higher is better · status real).
  Sums each roster goalie's goals saved above the snapshot's shots-weighted league-average save percentage.
- `starterShare` — Primary Goalie Game Ratio · 5-on-5 (share from 0 to 1 · higher is better · status real).
  Measures the starting goalie's share of team games started, with an announced alternate override.
- `plusMinusDefense` — Team Plus/Minus (Defense Context; Duplicate) · 5-on-5 (plus/minus points · higher is better · status real).
  Sums the team's skater plus/minus values in the defense section; higher is the production direction.
- `bottom6FwdDefense` — Bottom-6 Forwards Plus/Minus per Game · 5-on-5 (plus/minus per game per bottom-six forward · higher is better · status real).
  Averages plus/minus per game among the forwards ranked 7-12 by ice time per game (the third and fourth lines), with a single-game availability override when supplied.
- `bottomPairDDefense` — Bottom-Pair Defensemen Plus/Minus per Game · 5-on-5 (plus/minus per game per bottom-pair defenseman · higher is better · status real).
  Averages plus/minus per game among the defensemen ranked 5-6 by ice time per game (the third pair), with a single-game availability override when supplied.
- `blockedShots` — Blocked Shots / Game · 5-on-5 (blocked shots per game · higher is better · status real).
  Measures total blocked shots per game from the realtime team report.
- `shutouts` — Shut Outs · 5-on-5 (shutouts · higher is better · status real).
  Uses the team's total shutouts from the season summary.
- `pkGoalsPerMin` — Goals Allowed / PK Minute · Powerplay / Penalty Kill (goals allowed per penalty-kill minute · lower is better · status real).
  Measures goals allowed per penalty-kill minute.
- `pkShotsPerMin` — Shorthanded Opportunities / PK Minute (Proxy) · Powerplay / Penalty Kill (shorthanded opportunities per penalty-kill minute · lower is better · status proxy).
  Uses shorthanded opportunities per penalty-kill minute as the production proxy for shots allowed per penalty-kill minute.
- `pkTime` — Penalty-Kill TOI per Game (Def Zone Proxy) · Powerplay / Penalty Kill (penalty-kill seconds per game · lower is better · status proxy).
  Uses penalty-kill ice time per game as the production proxy for time in the defensive zone on the penalty kill.
- `pkBlockedShots` — Blocked Shots / Game (PK) · Powerplay / Penalty Kill (blocked shots per game scaled to PK workload · higher is better · status proxy).
  Scales total blocked shots per game by the team's penalty-kill share of its three major special-team/5-on-5 time components.
- `shGoalsFor` — Shorthanded Goals Scored · Powerplay / Penalty Kill (shorthanded goals · higher is better · status real).
  Uses total shorthanded goals scored across the target season.

## Overtime

Three-on-three and shootout outcomes.

- `otWinRatio` — OT Win Ratio (wins / opportunities) · 3-on-3 (production ratio from 0 to 1 · higher is better · status real).
  Measures OT-only wins over a denominator that still includes standing overtime losses, which may include shootout losses.
- `otTop3GoalShare` — Goals by Top 3 Players / Whole Team (OT) · 3-on-3 (ratio from 0 to 1 · higher is better · status real).
  Measures the share of team overtime goals scored by its top three overtime scorers.
- `otDifferentScorers` — Number of Different Goal Scorers (OT) · 3-on-3 (players · higher is better · status real).
  Counts distinct players with a recorded overtime goal.
- `otShots` — Shots / OT · 3-on-3 (OT shot-on-goal events per overtime game, excluding goals · higher is better · status real).
  Measures OT shot-on-goal events for per overtime game; goals are excluded by the current parser.
- `otShotsAgainst` — Shots Against / OT · 3-on-3 (OT shot-on-goal events against per overtime game, excluding goals · lower is better · status real).
  Measures OT shot-on-goal events against per overtime game; goals are excluded by the current parser.
- `otOffZoneTime` — Time in Offensive Zone / OT Game · 3-on-3 (normalized score; no raw measurement · higher is better · status none).
  Time in the offensive zone per overtime game is not exposed by the free NHL API used by production, so the metric is always neutral.
- `otDefZoneTime` — Time in Defensive Zone / OT Game · 3-on-3 (normalized score; no raw measurement · higher is better · status none).
  Time in the defensive zone per overtime game is not exposed by the free NHL API used by production, so the metric is always neutral.
- `otTalent` — Individual Talent Quality (OT) · 3-on-3 (points per game, summed across two players · higher is better · status proxy).
  Uses the sum of the best forward's and best defenseman's points per game as a proxy for individual overtime talent.
- `soWinRatio` — SO Win Ratio (wins / opportunities) · Shootout (ratio from 0 to 1 · higher is better · status real).
  Measures the share of shootout opportunities won.
- `soScorers` — Number of Different Scorers · Shootout (players · higher is better · status real).
  Counts skaters with at least one shootout goal.
- `soTalent` — Individual Talent Quality (SO) · Shootout (shooting ratio from 0 to 1 · higher is better · status real).
  Uses team shootout shooting percentage among skaters with shootout attempts.
- `soSavePct` — Team Shootout Save Percentage · Shootout (save percentage from 0 to 1 · higher is better · status real).
  Uses the team's official shootout save percentage.

## Opponents

Schedule-strength context derived from opponents' current power.

- `opponentAdjusted` — Opponent Strength (Avg Opponent Power) (standardized 0-100 section score and multiplier · higher is better · status real).
  Derives opponent strength from the current power scores of teams played, then exposes both a standardized opponent section score and the bounded factor used by the final score.

## Global

Outcome, comeback, special-team impact, physicality, and discipline signals.

- `globalOtWinRatio` — OT Wins Ratio (production ratio from 0 to 1 · higher is better · status real).
  Uses the same OT-only numerator and standing overtime-loss denominator as the overtime section.
- `regulationWinRatio` — Regulation Win Ratio (ratio from 0 to 1 · higher is better · status real).
  Measures the share of games won in regulation.
- `globalSoWinRatio` — SO Win Ratio (ratio from 0 to 1 · higher is better · status real).
  Uses the share of shootout opportunities won from the season standing.
- `comebackWins` — Comeback Wins (comeback wins · higher is better · status real).
  Counts wins after the team trailed at any point in a game.
- `twoGoalsComebackWins` — 2-Goal Comeback Wins (comeback wins · higher is better · status real).
  Counts wins after the team trailed by at least two goals.
- `last5MinComebacks` — Last 5-Minute Comeback Wins (comeback wins · higher is better · status real).
  Counts wins where the team was trailing at the five-minute checkpoint in the third period, inferred from the last scoring event at or before 5:00.
- `powerplayImpacts` — Powerplay Impacts (powerplay share of non-shorthanded goals · lower is better · status real).
  Uses the share of non-shorthanded goals scored on the powerplay; teams relying less on the powerplay rank higher.
- `penaltyKillImpacts` — Penalty Kill Impacts (non-powerplay, non-shorthanded residual share of goals against · higher is better · status real).
  Uses the share of goals against remaining after shorthanded and powerplay goals are removed; the residual can include empty-net goals.
- `winHighScoringChances` — Losses Despite High Scoring Chances (losses despite high-scoring chances · higher is better · status real).
  Counts losses where the team's play-by-play expected-goal proxy exceeded the opponent's actual goals.
- `physicality` — Team Physicality (standardized composite index · higher is better · status real).
  Aggregates roster size with physical-play rates into one composite: average height and weight of the active skaters, plus hits, penalty minutes, and takeaways per game. Each component is standardized across the league and combined with fixed weights, so mismatched raw units cannot let one component dominate.
- `discipline` — Team Discipline (standardized composite index · higher is better · status real).
  Aggregates penalty avoidance and workload balance into one composite: penalty minutes and short-handed situations per game (lower is better), the net penalty differential (penalties drawn minus taken, higher is better), the dispersion of even-strength ice time across the regulars (lower is better), and lead changes per game from the goal sequences (lower is better). Each component is standardized across the league and combined with fixed weights.
